rule.title: K-1 code AC interest is not a Schedule E figure when the proceeds went to an investment or to personal use

citation.wording: If the proceeds were used in an investment activity, report the interest on Form 4952. If the proceeds are used for personal purposes, the interest is generally not deductible.

rule.open_point: Investment interest reaches Schedule A line 9 only through Form 4952's limitation, which the tax software computes; the sheet counts the figure 0.00 on its row and keeps the printed amount.
